title: hemizygia humilis
intro: Hemizygia humilis, commonly known as Wild Chamomile, is a plant species within the Lamiaceae family native to tropical Africa. The health benefits of Hemizygia humilis include its potential to reduce inflammation, alleviate anxiety and insomnia, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its use as a calming agent, an anti-inflammatory, and an antioxidant, which contribute to its traditional use in treating various health issues. The bioactive constituents of Hemizygia humilis include essential oils, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
